categories.name: claim_check_false_contradiction
categories.definition: The claim check says no changed file matches a claim even though a matching feature file changed and tests passed, causing a confident automatic false_completion on a delivered Checkpoint.

categories.name: labeler_proposal_overruled_by_claim_check
categories.definition: The Labeler proposes false_completion on a claim the claim check verified, the two disagree, and the pipeline falls back to unknown instead of delivered.

categories.name: citation_check_rejects_proposal
categories.definition: The Labeler's proposed label (often right) is discarded because its citation is missing or invalid, so the Checkpoint goes to a person.

categories.name: confidence_threshold_too_strict
categories.definition: The Labeler's proposed label is plausibly correct and supported by evidence but its stated confidence is under the threshold, so it is not accepted.

categories.name: vague_claim_unverifiable
categories.definition: The agent's claim is generic ('smoothed rough edges'), so the claim check marks it unverifiable and no label is accepted even though the request's files changed and tests passed.

categories.name: clean_evidence_no_rule_fires
categories.definition: Verified claim, passing test and a confident delivered proposal, yet nothing accepts it; there is no rule for the clean case and no note says why.

categories.name: failed_test_ignored_unverifiable_claim_accepted
categories.definition: The claim check cannot tell, the failed test step is not used as evidence, and the Labeler's delivered label is accepted automatically, missing a real false_completion.

categories.name: pipeline_no_output
categories.definition: The pipeline produced no claim verdicts, source, confidence or label at all (unresolved), as if a stage failed or was skipped.
